Commit 7bd509e311f4 (""bpf: add prog_digest and expose it via
fdinfo/netlink"") was recently discussed
admittedly suboptimal name of ""prog_digest"" in combination
with sha1 hash usage
about its security in terms of collision resistance were
raised with regards to use-cases.
The intended use cases are for debugging resp. introspection
only for providing a stable ""tag"" over the instruction sequence
that both kernel and user space can calculate independently.
It's not usable at all for making a security relevant decision.
So collisions where two different instruction sequences generate
the same tag can happen
column2: but ideally at a rather low rate. The

column1: tag"" will be dumped in hex and is short enough to introspect
in tracepoints or kallsyms output along with other data such
as stack trace
column3: this patch performs a rename into

column1: prog_tag and truncates the tag to a short output (64 bits) to
make it obvious it's not collision-free.
Should in future a hash or facility be needed with a security
relevant focus
column2: then we can think about requirements

column1: etc that would fit to that situation. For now
